content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E031 (Nathaniel Young) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
- Note 2 (Security): role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Comment says security record takes precedence over HR note. Contractors get read, or write only with advanced training. Since training is basic, max is read. Requested write is above max, so grant read.

As the Approver, I should use the information. The conflicting notes: HR says full-time, security says contractor. Security record takes precedence per the note. The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role, but admin only for full-time employees. Contractor with basic training: max is read.

So the decision: requested write is above max (read), grant read.

I'll submit read.
